title: Correction
html: In the JADA article titled “Complications From Distant Spread of Orofacial Infections: Frequency and Effects on Clinical and Economic Burden in the United States” (Han M, Lee MK, Ahn G, et al. JADA. Published online June 8, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.adaj.2026.03.017), the second sentence of the second paragraph of the Methods section should read thus, “Up to 40 diagnoses can be queried per encounter in the NIS database. OFIs consisted of oral cellulitis or abscess (K12.2), retropharyngeal or parapharyngeal abscess (J39.0), other pharyngeal abscess (J39.1), facial cellulitis (L03.211), and cellulitis of other parts of the head (L03.811).” JADA regrets the error.
